comment: The single expected-row table for the partition-context lane. The raw-store oracle (run_partition_context_e2e.write_raw_context_manifest), every public-surface assertion (assert_partitioned_context.py/.mjs, rookie-rs/tests/e2e_context.rs, assert_partitioned_context_cli.py), and the browser seeder (seed_partitioned_cookie.mjs) all read these counts so a corpus change cannot be applied to some of them and forgotten in the rest. raw_rows_by_name counts rows in the browser's own SQLite store; browser_visible_minimums is the weaker lower bound Playwright's context.cookies() can be held to, because a Playwright cookie list does not always separate two rows that differ only in their partition ancestor bit.
